rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound describing cakraṃ
compound adjective describing cakraṃ as having a central pericarp

items.question: What form and status characterize the sixth cakra in this sequence?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified in sequence.
This cakra is described as royal.
This cakra possesses a central pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal eight-petaled center with a pericarp.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of rājānam as epithet or apposition is contextually inferred.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is royal, having eight petals and a pericarp.
